what_to_detect: A spell cast for its bestow cost resolves as an Aura attached to the creature it targeted.
near_miss: The same card cast for its mana cost resolves as a creature and attaches to nothing.
record_fields: gen-3 card lines[].cast_with (the Bestow keyword line)

what_to_detect: A bestowed casting has a legal creature to enchant.
near_miss: A bestowed casting with no creature to target has no legal target.
record_fields: the candidate's acting line, the Bestow keyword line

what_to_detect: A token copy of a bestowed Aura spell is a bestowed Aura on the battlefield: its enchanted-creature static contributes to the creature it is attached to.
near_miss: A token copy of the same card cast as a creature is a creature, with no enchanted creature to contribute to.
record_fields: snapshot entity token_script_id/copy_source and attached_to of the static's source

what_to_detect: A bestowed casting is judged as an Aura spell, so a restriction on creature spells does not stop it.
near_miss: The same card's creature casting is not playable under that restriction.
record_fields: the candidate's acting line, the Bestow keyword line

what_to_detect: A bestowed Aura spell whose target became illegal does not fizzle: it resolves as an enchantment creature spell.
near_miss: A non-bestowed Aura spell whose target became illegal fizzles.
record_fields: gen-3 card lines[].cast_with (the Bestow keyword line)

what_to_detect: A bestowed Aura whose enchanted creature left the battlefield stays on the battlefield, unattached, as an enchantment creature.
near_miss: An Aura not cast bestowed whose enchanted creature left goes to its owner's graveyard.

what_to_detect: A bestowed Aura that becomes attached illegally becomes unattached and an enchantment creature: its enchanted-creature static contributes to nothing.
near_miss: A bestowed Aura still legally attached keeps contributing to its creature.
record_fields: snapshot entity types and attached_to of the static's source

what_to_detect: A bestowed Aura that phases in unattached, its creature gone, is an enchantment creature: its enchanted-creature static contributes to nothing.
near_miss: A bestowed Aura that phases in together with its creature stays attached and keeps contributing.
record_fields: snapshot entity types and attached_to of the static's source
gen-3 designations bestowed and phased-out status
